meta.title: Music with a pulse
meta.summary: Turn it up a little. Cleveland’s rock legacy is one way into Ohio’s music story, but local stages, recordings, and the people in the crowd keep it moving.

blocks.text: Hey, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame connects performers, radio, recording, and audiences who changed popular music. Its Northeast Ohio collections also follow local musicians, labels, venues, and scenes. I like that change in scale: a sound can travel around the world and still begin on one particular street, station, or stage.

For a visit, let’s leave room for something happening now. A museum stop and a local performance make a lovely pair; concert halls, neighborhood venues, and festivals all add to the picture. Check current listings rather than assuming a familiar event is on. The next song is still being played somewhere. ♫
